control.title: Vulnerability management
control.description: Scan infrastructure, containers and dependencies for vulnerabilities and fix them within defined timelines (for example critical 15 days, high 30 days).

implementation_notes: Automated in CI/CD and monitored by the SRE on-call rotation.
evidence_hint: Vulnerability scan reports and remediation SLA tracking.
acceptance_criteria: Scan reports from the review period
Remediation timelines by severity are defined and tracked
Critical and high findings are fixed within the defined timelines or have approved exceptions

criteria_coverage.criterion: Scan reports from the review period
Remediation timelines by severity are defined and tracked
Critical and high findings are fixed within the defined timelines or have approved exceptions

automation.name: Amazon Web Services
tests: Amazon Inspector scans EC2, ECR or Lambda for vulnerabilities

automation.name: GitHub
tests: Dependabot vulnerability alerts enabled on all repositories
No critical or high Dependabot alerts open past the fix deadline

automation.name: Jamf Pro
tests: Macs run a supported macOS version

automation.name: Snyk
tests: Code and dependencies are being scanned by Snyk
No critical or high Snyk issues open past the fix deadline

automation.name: Tenable Vulnerability Management
tests: A vulnerability scan completed in the last 30 days
No critical or high vulnerabilities open past the fix deadline

requirements.title: Code review, VA and PT at least annually and before deployment
requirements.guidance: Source code review, VA and PT at least annually in authenticated mode, vendor certificates for code you don't own, security audit before any deployment, and recurring findings reported to the sub-committee.

requirements.title: Patch and change management
requirements.guidance: Apply critical patches immediately and test changes outside production first.

requirements.title: Internal audits, external audit, half-yearly VAPT and PCI reports
requirements.guidance: Quarterly internal and annual external audit reports to the IT committee, half-yearly VAPT, and PCI DSS AOC or ROC.

requirements.title: Configuration and vulnerability detection
requirements.guidance: Detect configuration changes and new vulnerabilities.

requirements.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
requirements.guidance: Find, evaluate and fix technical vulnerabilities in a timely way.

evidence.title: Vulnerability scan
